column1: # Each row: <file> TAB <pinned-bytes file> TAB <count> -- <file> must hold the exact bytes of the pinned file exactly
# <count> times (non-overlapping). Paths are relative to the constitution root. The pinned files under
# scripts/gates/relocated_copies/ are written byte-exact by the tool that writes the copies; never let an editor
# add or strip a newline in them. Changing a relocated clause means changing its pinned clause too (§11.4.35).
